next_steps: Complete the wrist examination: scaphoid tubercle tenderness and pain on axial thumb compression.
Request dedicated scaphoid-view radiographs; an initial X-ray can be normal.
If clinical suspicion remains despite normal X-rays: immobilise in a thumb spica splint and arrange repeat imaging or MRI.
Explain the plan and the risk of a missed scaphoid fracture (non-union, avascular necrosis) to the patient.
